hooks.name: Pre-deploy Build Gate
hooks.description: Before a terminal command runs, detect deploy commands (Vercel CLI or a `deploy` package script) and run `bun run build` first. Blocks the deploy (exit 2) if the build fails. Non-deploy commands pass straight through without building. Detection and the build command are defined in scripts/predeploy-build-gate.mjs with no hardcoded machine paths.
